title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling
title_zh: AgentJudgeBench：评估智能体工具调用中 LLM 评审器的多难度基准
abstract_en: LLM judges are widely used to evaluate agentic tool-calling systems, yet their reliability on structured, dependency-driven workflows remains largely unexamined. We present AgentJudgeBench, the first benchmark to systematically study LLM-as-a-judge reliability for agentic tool-calling over workflow DAGs, as distinct from the broader LLM-as-a-judge task of open-ended text or preference evaluation. The benchmark comprises 3,808 instances spanning six DAG topologies and three difficulty tiers, evaluated with five generators (3B-70B open-weight models and GPT-5.4) and six judges (20B to frontier scale) under paired with- and without-ground-truth conditions. Judge alignment degrades monotonically with task difficulty, 1.5x faster without ground truth, and on hard queries without ground truth all six judges converge to a narrow 77-82% band regardless of scale, revealing a structural ceiling driven primarily by task difficulty, though its height is partly prompt-dependent for weaker generators, that model capacity alone cannot overcome. Ground-truth exposure is not uniformly beneficial: it reduces alignment for GPT-5.4 (1.5 pp) and Gemini-2.5-Pro (3.9 pp), consistent with over-anchoring. Among mitigation strategies, chain-of-thought reasoning and judge temperature both have negligible effect, while structured evaluation rubrics improve alignment by up to 6.5 pp but do not generalize uniformly across judge-generator pairs. With ground truth, QwQ-32B best matches the programmatic reference, while a human validation study identifies GPT-OSS-120B as the most human-aligned judge; without it, frontier judges lead only marginally within the shared ceiling. These results expose fundamental limitations of current LLM judges and yield practical guidelines for reliable evaluation in agentic systems.
abstract_zh: LLM 评审器（LLM judges）已广泛用于评估智能体工具调用系统，但其在结构化、依赖驱动工作流中的可靠性仍缺乏系统研究。本文提出 AgentJudgeBench，这是首个针对基于工作流 DAG 的智能体工具调用、系统研究 LLM-as-a-judge 可靠性的基准，区别于开放式文本或偏好评估。该基准包含 3,808 个实例，覆盖 6 种 DAG 拓扑和 3 个难度等级，并在有无真实答案两种条件下，使用 5 个生成模型（3B–70B 开源模型及 GPT-5.4）和 6 个评审模型（20B 至前沿规模）进行评测。结果显示，评审器与程序化参考答案的一致性会随任务难度单调下降；在无真实答案时，下降速度快 1.5 倍。对于无真实答案的困难查询，6 个评审器无论规模大小都集中在 77%–82% 的狭窄区间，表明存在主要由任务难度造成的结构性上限，单纯增加模型容量无法突破该上限。提供真实答案并非总是有益：其使 GPT-5.4 和 Gemini-2.5-Pro 的一致性分别下降 1.5 和 3.9 个百分点，可能源于过度锚定。链式思考和评审温度几乎没有影响；结构化评估量规最多可提升 6.5 个百分点的一致性，但无法在所有评审器—生成器组合间稳定泛化。在有真实答案时，QwQ-32B 最接近程序化参考；人工验证则显示 GPT-OSS-120B 与人类判断最一致。无真实答案时，前沿评审器仅在这一共同上限内取得边际优势。研究揭示了当前 LLM 评审器的根本局限，并给出了面向智能体系统可靠评估的实践建议。
key_points_zh: AgentJudgeBench 包含 3,808 个实例，覆盖 6 种工作流 DAG 拓扑、3 个难度等级，以及有无真实答案两种评估条件。
评审一致性随任务难度下降；无真实答案的困难任务中，各模型稳定落在 77%–82% 区间，模型规模难以突破结构性上限。
真实答案并非总能提升可靠性，GPT-5.4 和 Gemini-2.5-Pro 反而因过度锚定而分别下降 1.5 和 3.9 个百分点。
链式思考与评审温度作用有限；结构化评估量规最多提升 6.5 个百分点，但跨模型组合泛化不稳定。
有真实答案时 QwQ-32B 最接近程序化参考、GPT-OSS-120B 最符合人类判断；无真实答案时前沿模型优势仅为边际提升。

llm_assessment.comment: This benchmark exposes structural weaknesses in LLM judging of dependency-driven tool workflows and offers actionable guidance for agent evaluation pipelines.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该基准揭示了LLM评判器在依赖驱动工具工作流中的结构性缺陷，并为Agent评测流程提供了可操作指导。
